problem: A native refresh can succeed after an earlier composed-text traversal failure. Qualification must retain that failure while preserving the existing treatment of temporary navigation errors.
behavior: Records exact effective READ_STATE and MARKER replies with source/manifest identities and ordered protocol calls. Observations and model requests are not rewritten.
Confirmed structured traversal-limit exceptions and proven profile-integrity mismatches remain latched across subsequent good reads.
Null reads during document setup and ordinary navigation/context errors are retained without automatically classifying them as profile-cap failures.
Successful reads require the expected profile metadata and native marker shape, including the final control-identity list. Returned records are detached from callers and sinks.
limits: This is a shared classifier. Benchmark, collector and whole-corpus admission integration remain in progress.
Replay uses immutable historical native V2 responses with identical snapshot/marker bytes, retaining their historical builder identity. It is not a new browser or model run.
Malformed event envelopes and persistence errors propagate to the transport; the integrating caller must retain an integrity failure and invalidate the attempt.
No model quality, task success, training qualification or superiority is established by these tests.
